card: ArenaSession: one driver per arena mode instead of ArenaGame's flag soup
deviations_from_card: case 5: practice grades ward words on a drill ledger attached to the clone (wardLedger is the drill, session.ledger is undefined). That is today's behaviour (watchContacts made a drill whenever this.ledger was unset), so it is kept instead of the card's 'undefined'. case 6 covers all 8 gate terms per the critic (holdFirstFrame, paused, labReplay, readerUp, flushPending, syncError, defeated, hidden) plus the all-clear row. step() takes InputFrame or a thunk, because ArenaInput.frame() consumes queued presses and the old ladder called it only where a branch used it (bot / reference / inactive season ticks). Commit 1 carries the module with its tests (the card's rollback plan), labelled test(...). Kinds: training, roster, tiro (local), season, practice, lab; the HUD mode stays the 4-value union.
notes: Red before: both test files failed on the missing module (7 cases: 6 in arena-session.test.ts plus bout-reader case 1). Green after: 9 tests pass, gate 735/735 vitest, 44/44 node, check:design 0; case 8 is the gate with replay goldens and VR vectors untouched (no core file changed). Seam for later waves: ArenaGame keeps a private `session` (ArenaSession) and `seasonSession`; transitions go through `apply(Entered, exitPrevious)`; the frame's step is `canStep({...}) -> session.step(() => input.frame())`, the shown state is `shownFrame(training, read, labReplay)`, and the ward ledger is `session.wardLedger()`. Mode/games/ledger/lab/practice/training/tape are read-only getters now (only `composition` is still written from outside, by compose.ts). Behaviour fixes by construction: endPractice now resets lastPerfect; restart from practice now also clears practice (it was left set before). Gate runs: the first run failed packages/tools/src/save.test.ts (sibling core data edits in flight changed the save source hash), the second failed vr:drift on a sibling commit landing mid-run; the third run, at the committed state, was green (exit 0). arena-entry.ts 1210 -> 1136 lines.
